title: skyhelper
description: This mod displays additional information on the Hypixel SkyBlock server
body:
This mod displays additional information on the Hypixel SkyBlock server, including: 1. Miner's ability cooldown: See exactly how much time is left until your ability recharges. 2. Kill streak extension timer: Keep track of how much time you have remaining to extend your current kill streak. commands: /hud setting report bug or you have idea [discord](https://discord.gg/A2ZfamBfHB) source code [github](https://github.com/padobus/skyhelper.git)
Required mods Fabric API
